provenance: SYNTHETIC QKD-session telemetry generated by qsh.qml_ids.attacks, the same call the shipped QCNN trains on, at seed 0. Class structure follows Al-Kuwari et al. (arXiv:2509.14282). No commercial-OK real QKD-attack corpus exists, which is why this is generated rather than collected - and why no number here is a performance claim about a real link.
licence: Generated by this repository - no third-party terms attach
attribution: Class structure per Al-Kuwari et al., arXiv:2509.14282. The rows themselves are produced by this repository's own generator.
note: AUC-PR 0.9915 against a 0.875 base rate is only a 1.13x lift. The high absolute number is an artefact of a corpus that is BALANCED ACROSS 8 CLASSES, seven of which are attacks - so 87.5% of rows are positive before any model looks at them. It is shown with its base rate for that reason. Note also that this plane collapses 8 classes to normal-versus-attack because the chart takes a binary label; the QCNN on this page is scored on 8-class macro F1 instead, and the two numbers are not comparable.
